输入队列已满，请稍后重试。: The input queue is full. Try again shortly.
已存在信任记录，不能覆盖原有指纹。: A trust record already exists. The saved fingerprint cannot be overwritten.
多个操作使用了相同的快捷键，请先解除冲突。: Multiple actions use the same shortcut. Resolve the conflict first.
无法读取拖入的本地文件，请从资源管理器拖入普通文件。: Cannot read the dropped file. Drag a regular file from Explorer.
暂不支持拖入文件夹或链接，请打开文件夹后选择普通文件。: Folder and link drops are not supported. Open the folder and select regular files.
请先打开一个磁盘或文件夹，再选择文件或下载位置。: Open a drive or folder before choosing files or a download destination.
请输入完整磁盘路径，例如 C:\\；网络共享请通过「选择文件夹」打开。: Enter a full drive path, such as C:\. Open network shares using Choose folder.
此磁盘不可用，请返回「此电脑」刷新磁盘列表。: This drive is unavailable. Return to This PC and refresh the drive list.
请先选择此文件所在的本地文件夹。: Select the local folder containing this file first.
为保护本地文件，暂不跟随符号链接或目录联接。: To protect local files, symbolic links and directory junctions are not followed.
目录超过 10,000 项，请选择更小的目录。: This directory has over 10,000 entries. Choose a smaller directory.
远端文件名不兼容 Windows，请先在远端重命名。: The remote file name is not compatible with Windows. Rename it on the remote server first.
仍有连接或文件传输正在运行。请先保存远端工作。: Connections or file transfers are still active. Save your remote work first.
退出将断开全部连接并取消传输，远端任务可能被终止。主机配置和已保存的片段会保留。: Exiting disconnects all sessions and cancels transfers. Remote tasks may stop. Host settings and saved snippets are kept.
在终端侧栏快速查找片段，选择目标会话后填入或确认执行。: Find snippets in the terminal sidebar. Choose a session to insert a command or confirm execution.
保存不会执行命令。使用时可选择填入，或检查目标后确认执行。: Saving never runs a command. Insert it later or review the target and confirm execution.
连接主机后即可使用片段: Connect to a host to use snippets
保存常用命令，在这里快速使用。: Save frequently used commands and access them here.
片段为空、过长或包含控制字符，请编辑后重试。: This snippet is empty, too long or contains control characters. Edit it and try again.
多行片段不能安全地直接填入，请复制检查，或选择确认执行。: Multiline snippets cannot be safely inserted without execution. Copy and review them, or choose confirmed execution.
目标会话已断开，请重新选择在线终端。: The target session is disconnected. Choose a connected terminal.
在此终端执行片段？: Run this snippet in the terminal?
片段已发送到目标终端: Snippet sent to the target terminal
请先确认目标终端处于 shell 提示符，且没有未提交的输入。多行片段可复制检查: Make sure the target is at a shell prompt with no pending input. Copy and review multiline snippets, or choose confirmed execution.
未发送命令，可修改选择后重试。: No command was sent. Adjust your selection and try again.
在当前终端查找并使用保存的命令: Find and use saved commands in the current terminal
